description: Conversion of existing rear staff accommodation unit to self contained studio flat
decision_conditions: The proposed flat would give rise to a poor and substandard living accommodation for the future occupiers of the flat by reason of poor outlook, poor privacy, noise and disturbance from the access road and the failure to demonstrate that living conditions would not be materially adversely affected by external noise and disturbance from noise arising from the nearby commercial uses, contrary to Policies 7 and 34 of the Havering Local Plan 2021 and Policy D6 of the London Plan 2021.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, it was necessary to issue a decision as close to the statutory timeframe as possible as opposed to seeking amendments which would have significantly delayed the application.
